project: Student Dropout Early Warning System - Bangladesh survey preparation
purpose: Collect 18 Bangladesh-specific predictor fields and one required current-status target. This does not make current status a future dropout outcome.

target.question: Current Academic Status
target.limitation: Running is the status observed at submission, not proof that the student will never drop out. Coding it as 0 follows the requested convention but does not establish a future outcome.

collection_boundary: Exactly 19 questions: 18 predictors and Current Academic Status. No consent, student ID, university name, date, email, or other research metadata questions. Handle required consent and governance separately.
missing_data_policy: Predictor questions are optional. Blank and Unknown / Prefer not to say or Undisclosed predictor responses remain missing. Current Academic Status is required. No imputation is performed.
synthetic_data_policy: No synthetic response dataset is distributed with the final project. Do not fabricate responses for training or evaluation.
income_bracket_note: Monthly household-income brackets are provisional survey categories, not official poverty or socioeconomic definitions.
occupation_schema_note: Bangladesh parent occupation categories are local survey labels and are not mapped to UCI occupation codes. The response data and current questionnaire use Not Alive and Housewife exactly.
gpa_note: GPA values remain as reported. No scale conversion is performed.

predictors.name: courses_enrolled
predictors.question: Courses enrolled in the relevant semester

predictors.name: evaluations_completed
predictors.question: Evaluations completed in the relevant semester

predictors.name: courses_passed
predictors.question: Courses passed in the relevant semester

predictors.name: family_financial_condition
predictors.question: Family financial condition (monthly household income bracket)
predictors.description: Provisional brackets, not official poverty definitions.

model_feature_policy: current_academic_status is a target only. Feature-set preparation selects the 18 predictor_fields and excludes the target. Do not use this label as an input feature.
